headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Qualcomm's Miss Drags Chips Lower a Second Day. The big swing: chip stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:32 AM and are now lower on the day — Yahoo Finance points to “Micron stock declines 12% as chip sell-off deepens”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip stocks gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 4.1% at 9:32 AM, now -8.8%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, TSMC. In the news: “Micron stock declines 12% as chip sell-off deepens” (Yahoo Finance).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 10:53 AM, high at 9:30 AM; -3.1% since the open.

themes.headline: Qualcomm's Miss Drags Chips Lower a Second Day
themes.detail: Apple -1.2%, Amazon -1.6%, AppLovin +30.0% on the day.

themes.headline: Cons. Staples leads, Cons. Discretionary lags
themes.detail: Since the open: Cons. Staples -1.3%, Cons. Discretionary -4.1%.
